description: NorWeST Stream Temperature Database is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NorWeST Regional Database and Modeled Stream Temperatures. Explore stream temperatures over time. The database was compiled by hundreds of biologists and hydrologists: it contains more than two hundred million hourly temperature recordings at more than 20,000 unique stream sites. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
